title.narrative: ANCHOR: Addressing basic needs of Conflict Affected Populations with multi-sector humanitarian response

description.narrative: Impact: The basic needs regarding food, WASH and shelter are fulfilled and protection risks reduced for conflict affected IDPs and most vulnerable groups in Kachin State and Sagaing Region.Outcome: Immediate needs of IDPs and host communities with regards to food, WASH and shelter in 37 IDP camps and 10 host communities in in the target area are met.

The project will provide support to Internally Displaced Persons(IDPs) and host communities affected by conflict and its humanitarian consequences. It is estimated that a total number of 26.659 people will be directly benefiting from this project; and around 10.853 people more will be indirectly benefiting from communal activities.The project will reach a total of at least 37.512 final beneficiaries.The main target group of the project are IDPs in camps.

The proposed action will support internally displaced persons affected by conflict and their respective host communities in 10 townships in Kachin State and 1 township in Sagaing region (41200 direct beneficiaries). The planned outputs include:1. IDPs in camps and members of host communities have access to safe, adequate, and equitable WASH facilities and services; 2. IDPs have access to safe and adequate shelter; 3. IDPs with special nutritional needs have access to adequate food.
